messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: quick UX question — should the SLO console 'nudge' teams to add fallback notify targets when an SLO has high fanout risk? :thinking:
Derek: Short answer: yes if we can show cost/latency impact. But we need safe defaults and an opt-out per org.
Samir: How are we defining 'fanout risk'? per-route subscriber count + notify-policy config? We already emit notify_fanout_estimate in telemetry.
Marta: We have `notify_targets_count` + `expected_fanout` from the estimator. Suggest a visible threshold (e.g. >5) to trigger a visual nudge card.
Aisha: Proposal: when expected_fanout > N, show compact card: "Add fallback targets (SMS / runbook / escalation) to avoid missed alerts if primary pagers hit quota" with one-click add. Also surface estimated extra tokens/cost and potential latency. Thoughts?
Derek: Implementation note: backend needs idempotent endpoint for the nudge action. Example API shim:
```
POST /v1/slo/{slo_id}/nudges
{ "flag": "fanout_fallback_suggested" }
```
Samir: Concern: don't want noisy suggestions. Only nudge when historical spike variance > X AND projected fanout > Y. Also track per-org dismissal to avoid repeating.
Marta: Telemetry we should capture: `nudge_shown`, `nudge_accepted`, `nudge_dismissed`, plus `estimate_fanout` and `org_quota_headroom`. Those feed into rollout and tuning.
deploy-bot: feature-flag:console.nudge.fanout -> canary rollout 20% -> started :rocket:
Aisha: Decision (tentative): build MVP: UI card + idempotent backend flag + telemetry events + org-level opt-out. I'll write RFC. @Marta can you sketch telemetry event shape? @Derek can you own API contract?
Derek: I'll own API and add schema in api-contracts repo. Draft event for telemetry: `event: nudge.interaction`, props: ["org_id","slo_id","action","estimate_fanout","sampling_rate"]. Will add proto soon.
Samir: One more: ensure automated systems (alerting infra, scripted rollbacks) can set header to suppress nudges: `X-No-Nudge: true`.
Aisha: Great. Filing RFC stub: https://go.redwood/rfc/slo-nudge-fallback (will fill). Sync tomorrow 10:00am to walk through UX copy and thresholds.
Marta: :thumbsup: I'll drop a telemetry sketch into the RFC and propose initial thresholds based on last 90d percentiles.
